environment_records.macos_meaning: Raw legal-file hashes and distribution metadata read from locally installed versioned packages. Presence in an environment describes availability. The CPU package requires only NumPy and Pillow.
environment_records.windows_meaning: Research constraints plus two independent CPU compatibility versions. The separately installed primary release is identified for SHARP, gsplat, PyTorch and torchvision. Other Windows rows identify the matching publisher-distributed Windows or universal wheel and the exact license members read from it. A publisher-wheel digest is its published SHA-256; it is not a measurement of the historical installed binary. Terms for system drivers and GPU tooling apply separately.
